I’m 16, based in Bangalore, and currently building something called DreamStack.
The idea is simple:
Right now, companies want experience.
But without opportunities, how do students or beginners actually gain that experience?
Marks don’t define skills. Resumes don’t show real capability.
DreamStack is focused on solving that —
by helping people work on real projects and turn that into verified proof of work that companies and institutions can trust.
Still in early stage. Looking for:
– Builders
– Teammates
– Guidance
– People who believe in solving real problems
If this connects with you, feel free to DM.
